[[FC Zbrojovka Brno (women)|Women's Football]] ''(defunct)'' }}}} '''FC Zbrojovka Brno''' is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Brno]], [[South Moravian Region]], Czech Republic and named after [[Zbrojovka Brno]], a firearms manufacturer. Founded in 1913 as '''SK Židenice''', the club later became known as Zbrojovka Brno. Brno won the [[Czechoslovak First League]] in the [[1977–78 Czechoslovak First League|1977–78 season]] and finished as runners-up in 1979–80."}}
